headline: Quarterly IT services growth was uneven, with AI‑driven winners offset by modest top‑line expansion at larger peers.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from sub‑2% at Infosys to over 50% at Coforge. Profit margins improved at HCLTech and Coforge, while Infosys trimmed guidance and Wipro saw profit dip. AI revenue contributed materially across the sector, boosting deal wins and margins for several firms. Dividend payouts remained stable but varied by company.

themes.title: AI‑led revenue acceleration
themes.detail: Companies such as HCLTech, LTM, Mphasis and TCS highlighted strong AI contributions, driving higher margins and new contract value.

themes.title: Margin divergence
themes.detail: Coforge raised EBIT margin guidance to 16%, while Infosys and Wipro faced pressure on operating margins.

themes.title: Guidance tightening
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue growth guidance to 1‑2%, reflecting cautious outlook despite AI momentum.

leaders.why: 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised EBIT margin guidance.
11.5% YoY revenue growth, 21% profit jump and $219 m AI revenue.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and FY27 guidance was cut.
